title: Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure
content:
SOP: Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure (SOP-INS-001)
DEPARTMENT: Insurance and TPA
VERSION: 4.0
ROLES: insurance_tpa, admission, billing
PURPOSE: Ensure timely submission and tracking of cashless pre-authorizations.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Insurance and TPA.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-INS-001 Insurance Pre-Authorisation Procedure v4.0, Section 4
